error[ZBX-E0555]: the registry refused a blob upload
  while  pushing an image
  cause  registry.test refused closing the upload for blob sha256:a479776e583f:
         it answered 400
  host   registry.test
  status 400
  code   DIGEST_INVALID
  blob   sha256:a479776e583f8f0bc6ad270726ef330db6133302ba80bc73d7fee3275b04a6c6
  fix    run the same command again; what the registry already holds is not sent twice
